run_train_model: run fairseq training on a dataset using cli_main with argparse options for data, arch, and save_dir
run_train_with_profiling: run fairseq training with CUDA and NVTX profiling enabled via the --profile flag
run_validate_model: run validation on a trained fairseq model subset using the validate function
run_validate_mega_lm: run chunked validation for mega language model tasks using validate_mega_lm
run_train_with_early_stopping: run fairseq training with early stopping based on validation patience and best checkpoint metric
